verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs describe it as "an open source platform," and the github.com/pulumi/pulumi repository is cited directly, so its source is publicly readable. The evidence never names the license and does not say which parts of the platform are open versus proprietary. missing for 10: explicit license name/terms (e.g., a LICENSE file citation), clarity on whether Pulumi Cloud/Neo/MCP server components are also open source, independent corroboration of license openness.
